reviews.review: Can completely break the game with a variety of builds and characters with friends. Still getting updates as well. Great roguelite.

A very fun game with some depth, and continuing developer support and content.  Good solo, but better with a full 4 person team.  The game was fun out the gate, and only became more entertaining with more unlocked.  My biggest critique of the game is that it took me a little too long to get my talent trees fully unlocked, simply because the final reincarnation difficulty modes add major changes to the game in the best way. 

You have your roguelite run with lots of weapon variety and power-ups that will earn you in game currency to increase your base stats between runs.  When you have completed all of the upgrades, that currency can still be spent in various ways during runs on the hardest difficulties.  There is also different horde style survival mode that is not affected by the stat upgrades, but can earn you currency as well.

Every character offers a unique play-style, with multiple possible builds that can be pursued during a run.  The characters are mostly balanced, with every character capable of having a few game breakingly strong builds, although in Reincarnation difficulty some characters have a much easier time breaking the game than others.

There are some minor bugs occasionally, but nothing that's really affected my run.  Meanwhile, they continue to put out new content every quarter, which so far +75% have been free.  The only other complain people really have is you can't join a lobby after it has started, which can be a bit frustrating when a friend logs on and you've been having a good run.

Edit:

Quarterly updates have become seasons with unique game modifiers that are absolutely keeping the game interesting.  Better still, you can replay past seasons, or just "vanilla." 
Also, sometimes the Chinese to English translations are kinda wonky, and I find it kind of funny.
I normally dislike roguelites, but this is one of my favorite games. Fun, challenging, and near infinite replayability.
